hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The portfolio is heavily weighted to crypto with most signals showing modest conviction and a risk‑on cross‑asset regime. However, several key crypto legs (LTC, SOL) exhibit low liquidity, negative alpha, and flat or negative composite scores, indicating fragility. To preserve capital we stay neutral overall, slightly scaling back exposure (multiplier 0.9) and nudging convictions: modestly up‑weight the higher‑liquidity, positive‑conviction leaders (BTC, ETH) while trimming the more vulnerable positions (LTC, SOL). The remaining altcoins lack volatility data and are left unchanged pending clea
